correctness.rationale: The proof explicitly decomposes the full matrix into all multiplicative-character sectors and the origin block. The trivial block has valuation e=2ceil((p-1)/6). All finite exponents lie below p-1, making the independent truncated-local-ring elimination exact for tested primes. Explicit cyclotomic cancellation proves rather than merely suggests the rank-four exceptional cases.
